levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: Three isnads for the book, not one saying: each «و رويته عن ...» is its own group. The first clause «عن علي بن جعفر» names the book's subject, not a link
«أخيه موسى بن جعفر» is one link (rule 7); the Imam written after «عن» inside the chain is narrator (owner ruling 2)
«فقد رويته بهذا الإسناد» closes the sentence about the book of Ali b. Ja'far, so it refers back to the route just before (route three), as back_reference; nothing is inherited
«و سعد بن عبد الله جميعا» converges with the Saffar on أحمد بن محمد بن عيسى (rule 3)
